lines.text: Baa baa black sheep, have you any wool? Yes sir, yes sir, three bags full!
Where does soft warm wool actually come from?
One for the master, and one for the dame, and one for the little boy down the lane!
Every spring, farmers give sheep a gentle haircut to keep them cool for summer!
The fluffy fleece is washed clean and spun into strong cozy yarn!
Knitting machines turn that yarn into warm winter hats, socks, and sweaters!
The wool grows right back on the sheep before winter returns!
Now you know where your cozy sweater came from with Baa Baa Black Sheep!
